from flask import Flask, request, make_response
import re

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/showName')
def name():
    '''
    Get "name" from the request, validate it,
    make a response with it, and return the response object
    '''
    # Retrieve the name parameter from the request
    name = request.args.get('name', '')
    
    # Validate the name to ensure it contains only alphanumeric characters and spaces
    if not re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9 ]+$', name):
        return make_response("Invalid name", 400)
    
    # If validation passes, create a response with the name
    response = make_response(f"Name: {name}")
    return response
